Features

Designed to stay out of your way.

Everything focuses on keeping the Windows experience clean, consistent and comfortable to use.

◐

Dark by default

A carefully balanced dark interface that looks great in both bright and low-light environments.

✦

Clean design

Minimal elements, consistent spacing and subtle details without unnecessary visual clutter.

⚡

Lightweight

Built with a focus on simplicity and performance, without unnecessary dependencies.

⊞

Windows inspired

Familiar visual language inspired by the modern Windows desktop experience.

◈

Open source

Explore the source code, customize it and contribute improvements through GitHub.

Terminal

```

npm run dev
